caption: The drawing features a single copper kettle placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The kettle is rendered in realistic detail, with a metallic, reddish-brown hue characteristic of copper and subtle variations in shading indicating its cylindrical shape and reflective surface. The body of the kettle is round and substantial, tapering slightly towards the top where a domed lid sits snugly, secured by a simple black knob. The spout is broad at the base, curving outward and upward, and has a small lid or cap at its tip. The handle is thick, arched, and attached to the top sides of the kettle with visible screws or rivets. There are slight highlights and shadows that suggest the direction of light comes from the upper left. The rest of the image is free of objects, and the drawing contains no additional motifs apart from a signature in the lower right corner.
title: Copper Kettle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
